dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent, high-contrast pale margins with sharp boundary sharpness against darker flight feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Low-contrast, diffuse transition from uniform gray crown/nape to patterned mantle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Synthetic identification bands (red and light blue) are visible on the tarsi.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive black facial mask covering the lores, subocular region, and throat; large, robust, pale-colored conical bill.
